title: Keep the domain’s DNS at GridCommerce
problem: A merchant couldn’t manage the DNS records of their own domain.
now: Point the nameservers here, then add, edit or delete any record; service templates, zone import and export, DNSSEC.
steps: Press Add record, choose A, name it shop and give an address.
Press Add for a service and add Google Search Console.
